- Next: run make lint, make test, and make test-long exactly as requested, then inspect git state and commit if all pass.

- make test-long is in progress and has already passed multiple HA scenarios under the ultra-long profile.
- Next: stay on make test-long until completion, then inspect diff/git status, commit, and run .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Requested validations all passed: make lint, make test, make test-long.
- Worktree contains unrelated dirty files outside this refactor, so the commit should include only the four src/ha files changed by this HA boundary cleanup.
- Next: stage src/ha/{state,startup,process_dispatch,worker}.rs, commit with a focused message, then run .ralph/task_switch.sh.
